title: Smiling Baby Sitting in High Chair, 1956 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black-and-white snapshot stamped 'JAN • 56' on the top white margin, capturing a smiling infant sitting in a wooden high chair equipped with a ruffle-trimmed cushion and food tray. The infant looks joyfully toward the camera with a wide, open-mouthed grin. An exposed brick wall and indoor potted foliage in the background reflect a cozy mid-century American home setting.
